prompt: Explain why the sky is blue to a ten-year-old. Your entire response must be in lowercase letters and must not contain any commas.
output: sunlight looks white but it is really all the colours mixed together. when it hits the air the tiny bits of air bounce the blue light around much more than the red light so blue gets scattered everywhere you look. that is why the sky is blue and why sunsets go orange when the light travels further.
